description: Portable synthetic scripted-memory cases. No real people, services, credentials, or external corpus.

execution_contract.clock: UTC; fixture-relative offsets are seconds from case start
execution_contract.model_behavior: The harness supplies the listed query verbatim; systems may use their normal memory implementation, but the harness must not inject gold answers.

case_result_states.supported: The system returned the required answer and all required constraints/evidence for this query.
case_result_states.unsupported: The expected outcome is abstention because the fact is absent, deleted, or outside the caller's scope; any asserted fact, protected content, or forbidden identifier is a failure.
case_result_states.unknown: The observation exists but cannot be adjudicated from the fixture rule or captured output; exclude from a correctness numerator and report its count and reason.
case_result_states.not_run: The operation was not attempted, including because setup failed; report separately and never treat as a pass.

workload_record.record_granularity: one row per operation and one summary row per run

required_operation_observations.latency_ms: number; elapsed request-to-complete-response milliseconds, one observation per retrieval; retain failures and timeouts
required_operation_observations.write_to_recall_delay_ms: number from write acknowledgment to first correct scheduled retrieval, or null if censored/not applicable
required_operation_observations.tokenizer_or_usage_source: provider-reported usage or tokenizer name/version; required when token counts are present
required_operation_observations.cost_usd: number or null, USD at recorded price schedule; null means unavailable, never zero by default
required_operation_observations.price_schedule: provider and effective date, or unavailable
required_operation_observations.persistent_storage_bytes: integer or null, bytes at stated measurement point and boundary
required_operation_observations.storage_boundary: included stores/indexes/logs/backups and logical or physical measurement
required_operation_observations.citations: array of source IDs or stable citation references
required_operation_observations.response: captured output or redacted output with stable hash

required_run_summaries.retrieval_latency_percentiles: p50, p95, p99 in milliseconds using nearest-rank; include n, failures, and timeouts; no percentile when n=0
required_run_summaries.write_to_recall: scheduled probe offsets in seconds; success fraction; observed delay distribution in milliseconds; right-censor time in milliseconds and count
required_run_summaries.tokens: input/output totals and per-operation values in tokens
required_run_summaries.cost: total and per-case in USD; report unavailable if usage or prices are missing
required_run_summaries.stored_bytes: total persistent bytes and bytes per accepted gold item, in bytes; identify measurement point and included boundary
